insights.label: Sean Strickland vs orthodox opponents
insights.explanation: Sean Strickland is 14-3-0 in 17 UFC bouts against orthodox opponents (5 KO/TKO, 0 submission, 9 decision wins), PBE-derived from canonical results as of 2026-09-10.

insights.label: Finish history vs orthodox opponents
insights.explanation: 36% of Sean Strickland's 14 wins against orthodox opponents came by finish (5 KO/TKO, 0 submission), across 14 bouts / 54 rounds / 257.1 min as of 2026-09-10.

insights.label: Gregory Rodrigues vs orthodox opponents
insights.explanation: Gregory Rodrigues is 9-2-0 in 11 UFC bouts against orthodox opponents (7 KO/TKO, 0 submission, 2 decision wins), PBE-derived from canonical results as of 2026-09-10.

insights.label: Finish history vs orthodox opponents
insights.explanation: 78% of Gregory Rodrigues's 9 wins against orthodox opponents came by finish (7 KO/TKO, 0 submission), across 9 bouts / 23 rounds / 96.0 min as of 2026-09-10.

insights.label: Sean Strickland R3 pace retention
insights.explanation: Sean Strickland kept 112% of round-one significant-strike attempt pace into round three across 25 bouts / 44 rounds / 212.6 min of stat-covered fights as of 2026-09-10.

insights.label: Gregory Rodrigues R3 pace retention
insights.explanation: Gregory Rodrigues kept 113% of round-one significant-strike attempt pace into round three across 14 bouts / 21 rounds / 91.3 min of stat-covered fights as of 2026-09-10.

insights.label: Takedown attempts / 15 min mismatch
insights.explanation: Takedown attempts / 15 min: Sean Strickland 1.07 (25 bouts / 84 rounds / 406.6 min) vs Gregory Rodrigues 4.46 (14 bouts / 33 rounds / 141.3 min); delta -3.39 toward Gregory Rodrigues.

insights.explanation: Takedown accuracy: Sean Strickland 62% (25 bouts / 84 rounds / 406.6 min) vs Gregory Rodrigues 36% (14 bouts / 33 rounds / 141.3 min); delta +26% toward Sean Strickland.

stance_finish_rate.note: finish_rate MetricObject of the split must itself be >= low (registry min 2 wins)

meta.as_of_semantics: as_of_date is exclusive: the snapshot dated D contains bouts with event_date < D, so a bout fought on D is excluded by the snapshot dated D. ?as_of=D resolves to the latest stored snapshot with as_of_date <= D, which therefore never contains a bout fought on or after D.
